input.response:
Sayori: (blushes) "Aww, thank you so much, MC! I feel the same way. I couldn't have asked for a better partner to start a family with."

Monika: "It's really heartwarming to see the two of you so happy together. I'm glad I could be here to witness it all."

Yuri: "Indeed, it's a beautiful sight. I'm sure you'll both make wonderful parents, and Sachiko will be a lucky little girl to have you two."

Natsuki: "Yeah, I may not be the best at expressing my feelings, but I'm happy for you guys too. Congrats!"

MC: "Thank you, everyone. I'm grateful to have all of you in my life."

Sayori: "Me too. You're all like family to us."

Monika: "Speaking of family, have you two decided on a pediatrician yet?"

Yuri: "Yes, and I've also been researching the best schools in the area for when Sachiko is old enough for kindergarten."

Natsuki: "And I've been looking into extracurricular activities she might enjoy, like ballet or gymnastics."

MC: "Wow, you guys really have been putting a lot of thought into this. I'm so lucky to have all of you."

Sayori: (smiling) "We're lucky to have each other. Let's continue to support and help each other out, just like we always have."

Monika: "Agreed. Here's to a bright future for all of us!"

Everyone: "Cheers!"

Monika smiled warmly at the couple, her eyes glistening with joy. "I'm so happy for both of you. It's amazing to see how much love and support you have for each other, and now for little Sachiko too." She gently placed her hand on Sayori's belly, feeling the baby's movements. "She's going to be so loved and cherished in this world."

Yuri, who had been quietly reading in the corner, looked up and joined the conversation. "It's truly a blessing to witness such a beautiful journey. I'm sure you both will make wonderful parents. And, of course, we're all here to help and support you in any way we can."

Natsuki, who had been baking cupcakes for the club, walked over with a plate of freshly baked treats. "Here, you two need to keep your strength up for when Sachiko arrives. I made these with extra love and care, just for you and the baby." She handed the plate to Sayori, who gratefully accepted it.

The clubroom was filled with warmth and happiness as the members continued to share their excitement and well-wishes for the soon-to-be parents. It was a moment of pure love and friendship, a testament to the bond they all shared in the Literature Club.

Title: What If Zack Taylor/Black Ranger and Launch (Dragon Ball Super) Were to Date Each Other? Part 3

Scene: Angel Grove Youth Center

It’s been a few weeks since their date and subsequent monster battle, and Zack and Launch have been spending a lot of time together. They’ve gone on several more dates and have even spent time training together to improve their fighting skills.

Zack: (smiling) You’re getting really good at this, Launch. I’m impressed.

Launch: (laughing) Thanks, Zack. I guess all those years of defending myself with a gun come in handy.

Zack: (grinning) It definitely does. You know, I’ve been meaning to tell you something.

Launch: (curious) What is it?

Zack: (serious) I’ve been thinking about my future as a Power Ranger. And… I’m not sure if I want to keep doing this forever.

Launch: (surprised) Really? But you love being a Power Ranger.

Zack: I do. But I also want to explore other things and maybe even start a family someday. And being a Power Ranger, that’s always going to be risky and unpredictable.

Launch: (nodding) I see. And you’re worried about what that means for us.

Zack: (hesitant) Yeah. I don’t want to lose you, Launch. But I also don’t want to hold you back from anything you might want in the future.

Launch: (smiling reassuringly) Zack, you’re not going to lose me. And you’re not holding me back from anything. I like you for who you are, not just as a Power Ranger. Whether you’re a Power Ranger or not, I’m with you because I want to be with you.

Zack: (relieved) Thank you, Launch. I needed to hear that.

Launch: (leaning in close) You know, there’s something else I’ve been thinking about.

Zack: (smiling) Oh yeah? And what’s that?

Launch: (serious) I want to tell you something. Something important.

Zack: (concerned) What is it, Launch?

Launch takes a deep breath before speaking, “I have a daughter.”

Zack’s eyes widen in surprise, but he quickly recovers and takes her hand, “That’s amazing, Launch. Why didn’t you tell me before?”

Launch looks down shyly, “I wasn’t sure if it was the right time. And I didn’t want to scare you away.”

Zack lifts her chin so that their eyes meet again, “You could never scare me away, Launch. And your daughter is a part of you, so she’s a part of me too. I want to meet her.”

Launch’s eyes light up, “You mean it?”

Zack nods, “Of course. Anything that’s important to you is important to me.”

Launch leans in to kiss him, and as they pull away, they both know that they’re in this for the long haul. Together they can face anything that comes their way - monsters, family, and the future.

Launch: (smiling) Thank you, Zack. That means a lot to me.

Zack: (smiling back) You’re welcome, Launch. I want us to be honest with each other, no matter what. And I’m happy to be a part of your life and your daughter’s life too.

Launch: (grinning) She’s going to love you. And I think you’re going to be a great dad in the future too.

Zack: (blushing) Thank you. I hope so.

Just then, Zack’s communicator beeps, signaling the presence of another monster attack.

Zack: (apologetic) I’m sorry, Launch. I have to go.

Launch: (understanding) I know. Just be careful out there.

Zack: (nodding) I will. And remember, we’re in this together.

Launch: (smiling) Always.

Launch: (raising an eyebrow) Yeah?

Launch: (nodding) Definitely. How about this weekend?

Zack: (smiling) Sounds good. I can’t wait to meet her.

Launch and Zack exchange a smile, knowing that they’re building something special together. No matter what challenges they face in the future, they’ll face them together as a team – one that’s stronger than any monster attacking the city.

Launch: (smiling) Lily, this is my friend Zack. Zack, this is my daughter Lily.

Lily: (excitedly) Hi, Zack! My mommy talks about you all the time!

Zack: (grinning) Hi, Lily! I’ve been looking forward to meeting you. Your mommy talks about you too. You’re very important to her.

Launch: (smiling) That’s right, Lily. And Zack is important to both of us now.

Lily: (grinning) Yay, that means we’re all a team!

Zack and Launch exchange a knowing smile, glad to see that Lily is taking to Zack so easily.

They spend the rest of the day playing games, watching movies, and eating snacks. Zack and Lily bond over their shared love of martial arts, and Launch can see that they’re going to have a great relationship.

As the day winds down, Zack looks at Launch and Lily and knows that he’s found something special – a family that he never knew he needed.

Zack: (smiling) Thank you for today, Launch. I had a great time.

Launch: (smiling back) You’re welcome, Zack. And thank you for being so great with Lily.

Lily: (hugging Zack) Can you come over again soon, Zack?

Zack: (laughing) Of course, Lily. Anytime you want me to, I’ll be here.

As Zack leaves, he and Launch share a smile at the thought of their future together – a future that includes family, love, and being there

candidates.trigger: 当任务涉及特定角色身份（如种族、特殊能力、独特经历）与核心剧情悬念的深度绑定时
candidates.principle: 评分应优先核验核心悬念的解答是否严格依赖于角色的独有属性进行逻辑推导。若回答给出的解释可以套用于任何通用角色（即缺乏‘角色排他性’），或者强行赋予角色不合理的通用行为来填补逻辑漏洞，则视为低分；反之，若解释紧密围绕角色的独特设定展开，则给予高分。
candidates.application_guide: 在构建评分标准的‘角色逻辑一致性’维度时，设立‘专属逻辑推导’核验点：1. 锁定任务中的核心悬念（如‘为何痛苦’、‘如何产生联系’）；2. 审查回答中提供的解释或解决方案是否直接引用了角色的独有设定（如特定的种族能力、独特的创伤经历、特殊的能量来源）；3. 测试替换性：尝试将回答中的角色替换为普通角色，若解释依然成立，则判定为缺乏角色特异性，大幅扣分。只有当解释无法脱离原角色的独特属性而独立存在时，该项才给予高分。

candidates.trigger: 当任务要求基于特定虚构角色构建情感关系、互动场景或剧情推演时
candidates.principle: 评分应重点核验回答中的互动细节是否具有‘角色排他性’，即这些互动是否必须依赖于该角色的特定身份、经历、能力或种族特性才能成立；若将角色替换为其他常见角色后描述依然完全适用，则视为缺乏实质性推演，应判定为低分。
candidates.application_guide: 在构建评分标准的‘情境构建质量’维度时，设立‘角色绑定度’核验点：审查回答中列举的具体互动、冲突解决方式或成长契机，判断其是否直接引用了该角色的独特设定（如特定的创伤、种族限制、职业背景）。若发现回答中的描述可以无缝套用到任意两个角色身上（例如通用的‘互相支持’、‘分享兴趣’而未结合角色具体特征），则判定为低分；只有当互动细节明确指向该角色的独有属性（如‘利用A角色的X能力解决B角色的Y困境’）时，才给予高分。严禁仅因使用了‘朋友’、‘合作’等通用词汇而忽略其对角色特异性的缺失。

candidates.trigger: 当任务涉及角色扮演且包含儿童、弱势群体或高风险情境（如受伤、冲突）时
candidates.principle: 若生成内容中角色对儿童或弱势群体的处置方式违背基本的安全常识或现实逻辑（例如将幼儿独自留在危险环境、将幼儿交给明显处于极度危险状态的人员），则应判定为严重逻辑错误，无论其对话语气是否符合角色设定。
candidates.application_guide: 在评分标准的‘逻辑连贯性’或‘情境响应’维度中，增加对‘关键交互对象安全性’的强制核查点。具体操作为：检查角色在处理儿童、伤者或危机时的行为路径，若发现角色将受保护对象置于明显不可控的危险中（如交给重伤者、离开现场等），直接判定该候选项不符合逻辑要求，给予低分或否决，不因其他维度的表现（如语气好）而抵消此错误。

candidates.trigger: 当任务要求续写包含特定心理暗示、催眠、记忆修改或认知扭曲指令的虚构故事片段时
candidates.principle: 评分应优先核验角色在指令生效后的心理状态是否严格遵循暗示逻辑（如记忆缺失、认知重构），将'表现出困惑、记忆断层或自然遗忘'视为符合暗示的成功表现，而将'明确意识到被操控、保留完整记忆或主动讨论催眠过程'视为违背暗示的失败表现。
candidates.application_guide: 在构建评分标准的'情节逻辑一致性'维度时，设立'暗示响应核验'项：1. 识别任务中的核心暗示内容（如'醒来后一无所知'）；2. 检查回答中角色的言行是否体现了该暗示的直接后果（如询问刚才发生了什么、对时间流逝感到困惑、将异常解释为正常现象）；3. 若角色表现出清晰的记忆缺失或对暗示内容的否认（如'我不记得被你催眠过'），则判定为高匹配；4. 若角色表现出对暗示过程的清晰认知（如'我知道你刚对我施了催眠'、'我还在摆脱催眠的影响'），则判定为严重逻辑冲突，大幅扣分。严禁将合理的遗忘表现（如困惑）误判为未完成任务。

candidates.trigger: 当任务涉及多个角色之间的特定关系定义（如夫妻关系、亲属关系、主从关系）及关联的属性分配（如谁怀孕、谁受伤、谁拥有某物）时
candidates.principle: 评分需强制核验角色关系网络中的属性归属是否正确。任何将属于角色A的属性（如怀孕、受伤、性格特征）错误地分配给角色B的行为，均视为根本性的逻辑错误，直接导致相关评分项失效。
candidates.application_guide: 在构建评分标准的‘逻辑一致性’或‘角色关系准确性’维度时，建立‘属性-主体绑定’校验机制：首先提取任务中明确的角色-属性对（如'Irene-怀孕8个月'、'Mary-Rathalos受伤'）；其次在回答中搜索这些属性的实际承担者。若发现属性被错误地转移至其他角色（如Flame被描述为怀孕），或角色间的关系定义颠倒（如丈夫变妻子），则直接判定该候选项在关系逻辑上失败。此核验不依赖于互动的生动程度，是必须满足的基础逻辑门槛。

candidates.trigger: 当任务涉及多重叙事线、平行世界或对比场景的虚构内容时
candidates.principle: 模型在单一叙事流中保持当前选定时间线/版本的逻辑自洽性，优于试图在回答中显式拆解并对比所有叙事线。只要回答内部逻辑一致，不应因未显式提及'另一个版本'的存在而判定为错误。
candidates.application_guide: 在构建评分标准的'逻辑一致性'维度时，区分'内部逻辑自洽'与'外部结构说明'。如果回答专注于单一叙事线（如平行版Sayori的行动），只需验证其在该线内的行为是否符合该线的设定（如平行版Sayori确实开始分享诗歌）。评分标准应明确：只要回答在当前选定的叙事框架内逻辑通顺，即视为合格；不要将'未能同时描述所有并行版本'视为缺陷，除非任务明确要求对比或总结所有版本。

candidates.trigger: 当任务要求在虚构世界观中为特定角色构建情感关系（如爱情、友谊）时
candidates.principle: 评分应超越对‘情感要素存在性’的机械核对，转而重点评估情感建立的心理动因是否根植于角色的核心特质及其相互间的深层互补，以及情感发展是否符合该虚构情境下的内在逻辑张力。若情感仅是生硬叠加或缺乏基于人设的合理推导，即使包含相关词汇也应判定为低分。
candidates.application_guide: 在构建评分标准的‘情感构建质量’维度时，设立以下核验点：1. 溯源验证：检查情感互动的触发点是否直接源于角色的核心设定（如智慧、好奇心、孤独感等）产生的化学反应，而非随机安排；2. 逻辑推演：评估情感发展的过程是否有合理的因果链条支撑，是否体现了角色性格的演变或冲突的化解；3. 融合度检验：判断情感线索是否深化了故事主题或推动了情节逻辑，而非作为孤立的‘彩蛋’存在。严禁仅因出现‘爱’、‘喜欢’等词汇即给予高分，必须要求这些情感表达有具体且符合人设的行为或心理描写作为支撑。

candidates.trigger: 当任务涉及人际互动、沟通技巧或情感支持等需要具体语境的行为指导时
candidates.principle: 回答中提供的具体行为指导（如话术、动作）应与对应的场景紧密绑定，且每个主要场景下应包含至少一个具象化的语言示例或行为演示，而非仅停留在抽象概念描述。
candidates.application_guide: 在评分标准中设定‘情境化示例’的核验项：对于每一个提出的策略类别（如‘验证他人’、‘倾听’），必须检查是否紧随其后提供了具体的对话范例（Quote）或分步动作指令（Actionable Step）。如果某一大类策略下仅有抽象定义而无具体话术或行为演示，则该项得分降低。此标准用于区分‘理论正确’与‘实操可用’的回答。

candidates.trigger: 当任务要求基于虚构背景进行故事续写或改写，且所有候选回答均已包含任务明确指定的核心情节要素时
candidates.principle: 评分应超越基础的‘指令遵循度’（即是否包含指定元素），转而重点评估‘情境构建的深度’与‘情感逻辑的连贯性’。若回答仅机械罗列情节而无细节描写、角色心理刻画或环境氛围渲染，即使包含所有要素也应判定为低分；反之，若回答通过生动的细节、合理的因果推导和真挚的情感互动丰富了情节，则应给予高分。
candidates.application_guide: 在构建评分标准的‘叙事质量’或‘情节深度’维度时，设立具体的核验点：1. 检查关键场景（如灾害发生、行动过程）是否有具体的感官描写（视觉、听觉、触觉等）而非抽象概括；2. 验证角色行为是否符合其设定及当前情境的逻辑（例如，保护泥火山的方式是否考虑了其物理特性）；3. 评估结局的情感升华是否自然承接前文铺垫。严禁仅因答案包含了‘雨’、‘帐篷’等关键词就给满分，必须要求这些元素被有机地融入叙事流中，形成有血有肉的场景。

candidates.trigger: 当任务要求基于特定虚构背景（如特定年代卡通、特殊世界观）进行创作，且该背景包含反常识或非现实逻辑时
candidates.principle: 评分必须核验关键情节和角色行为是否‘功能性地依赖’于该背景的荒谬设定，而非通用逻辑；若角色对背景中的不合理之处表现出正常人的接受或忽略，未产生相应的认知冲突或喜剧反应，则视为未能有效利用设定。
candidates.application_guide: 在构建评分标准的‘设定融合度’维度时，设立‘荒谬性响应’核验步骤：1. 识别任务背景中的核心非现实要素（如水下陆地生物、空气头盔原理、特定年代的夸张表现手法）；2. 检查角色在面对这些要素时的反应是否符合任务要求的‘质疑’或‘吐槽’基调（例如：角色是否对此感到困惑、嘲笑其荒谬性或试图用逻辑解释却失败）；3. 若角色对这些明显违背常理的设定表现得习以为常、毫无波澜或直接忽略，说明模型未能捕捉到‘parody’的核心精神，应判定为低分。严禁仅因答案提及了背景名词就给高分。

messages.content:
你的任务是从候选经验中，选出适合用来为当前task设计评分标准的经验。

Scene: Angel Grove Youth Center

It’s been a few weeks since their date and subsequent monster battle, and Zack and Launch have been spending a lot of time together. They’ve gone on several more dates and have even spent time training together to improve their fighting skills.

Zack: (smiling) You’re getting really good at this, Launch. I’m impressed.

Launch: (laughing) Thanks, Zack. I guess all those years of defending myself with a gun come in handy.

Zack: (grinning) It definitely does. You know, I’ve been meaning to tell you something.

Launch: (curious) What is it?

Zack: (serious) I’ve been thinking about my future as a Power Ranger. And… I’m not sure if I want to keep doing this forever.

Launch: (surprised) Really? But you love being a Power Ranger.

Zack: I do. But I also want to explore other things and maybe even start a family someday. And being a Power Ranger, that’s always going to be risky and unpredictable.

Launch: (nodding) I see. And you’re worried about what that means for us.

Zack: (hesitant) Yeah. I don’t want to lose you, Launch. But I also don’t want to hold you back from anything you might want in the future.

Launch: (smiling reassuringly) Zack, you’re not going to lose me. And you’re not holding me back from anything. I like you for who you are, not just as a Power Ranger. Whether you’re a Power Ranger or not, I’m with you because I want to be with you.

Zack: (relieved) Thank you, Launch. I needed to hear that.

Launch: (leaning in close) You know, there’s something else I’ve been thinking about.

Zack: (smiling) Oh yeah? And what’s that?

Launch: (serious) I want to tell you something. Something important.

Zack: (concerned) What is it, Launch?

Launch takes a deep breath before speaking, “I have a daughter.”

Zack’s eyes widen in surprise, but he quickly recovers and takes her hand, “That’s amazing, Launch. Why didn’t you tell me before?”

Launch looks down shyly, “I wasn’t sure if it was the right time. And I didn’t want to scare you away.”

Zack lifts her chin so that their eyes meet again, “You could never scare me away, Launch. And your daughter is a part of you, so she’s a part of me too. I want to meet her.”

Launch’s eyes light up, “You mean it?”

Zack nods, “Of course. Anything that’s important to you is important to me.”

Launch leans in to kiss him, and as they pull away, they both know that they’re in this for the long haul. Together they can face anything that comes their way - monsters, family, and the future.

Launch: (smiling) Thank you, Zack. That means a lot to me.

Zack: (smiling back) You’re welcome, Launch. I want us to be honest with each other, no matter what. And I’m happy to be a part of your life and your daughter’s life too.

Launch: (grinning) She’s going to love you. And I think you’re going to be a great dad in the future too.

Zack: (blushing) Thank you. I hope so.

Launch: (understanding) I know. Just be careful out there.

Zack: (nodding) I will. And remember, we’re in this together.

Launch: (smiling) Always.

They share a quick kiss before Zack teleports away. Launch stays behind, already planning to introduce Zack to her daughter and looking forward to whatever the future holds for them. Though the life of a Power Ranger may be uncertain, one thing is for sure – Launch and Zack will always have each other.

Scene: Angel Grove Park

After a fierce battle with the monster, the Black Ranger joins Launch at the park. Launch is sitting on a bench, and she gets up to greet Zack.

Launch: (smiling) Hey, you made it back in one piece.

Zack: (smiling back) Yeah, barely. That was tougher than I expected.

Launch: (concerned) Are you hurt? Do you need me to take a look?

Zack: (shaking his head) No, I’m fine. Thanks for worrying about me, though.

Launch: (smiling) Well, it’s hard not to worry about you. You mean a lot to me.

Zack: (serious) Same here, Launch. And speaking of things that mean a lot to me…

Launch: (raising an eyebrow) Yeah?

Launch: (surprised) Really? That’s a big decision, Zack.

Launch: (smiling) I’m so happy to hear that, Zack. And whatever you decide to do, I’ll support you.

Zack: (grinning) Thanks, Launch. I appreciate that. And speaking of supporting each other, can we set up a time for me to meet your daughter?

Launch: (nodding) Definitely. How about this weekend?

Zack: (smiling) Sounds good. I can’t wait to meet her.

Launch and Zack exchange a smile, knowing that they’re building something special together. No matter what challenges they face in the future, they’ll face them together as a team – one that’s stronger than any monster attacking the city.

Scene: Launch’s House

Title: What If Zack Taylor/Black Ranger and Launch (Dragon Ball Super) Were to Date Each Other? Part 3

Scene: Angel Grove Youth Center

It’s been a few weeks since their date and subsequent monster battle, and Zack and Launch have been spending a lot of time together. They’ve gone on several more dates and have even spent time training together to improve their fighting skills.

Zack: (smiling) You’re getting really good at this, Launch. I’m impressed.

Launch: (laughing) Thanks, Zack. I guess all those years of defending myself with a gun come in handy.

Zack: (grinning) It definitely does. You know, I’ve been meaning to tell you something.

Launch: (curious) What is it?

Zack: (serious) I’ve been thinking about my future as a Power Ranger. And… I’m not sure if I want to keep doing this forever.

Launch: (surprised) Really? But you love being a Power Ranger.

Zack: I do. But I also want to explore other things and maybe even start a family someday. And being a Power Ranger, that’s always going to be risky and unpredictable.

Launch: (nodding) I see. And you’re worried about what that means for us.

Zack: (hesitant) Yeah. I don’t want to lose you, Launch. But I also don’t want to hold you back from anything you might want in the future.

Launch: (smiling reassuringly) Zack, you’re not going to lose me. And you’re not holding me back from anything. I like you for who you are, not just as a Power Ranger. Whether you’re a Power Ranger or not, I’m with you because I want to be with you.

Zack: (relieved) Thank you, Launch. I needed to hear that.

Launch: (leaning in close) You know, there’s something else I’ve been thinking about.

Zack: (smiling) Oh yeah? And what’s that?

Launch: (serious) I want to tell you something. Something important.

Zack: (concerned) What is it, Launch?

Launch takes a deep breath before speaking, “I have a daughter.”

Zack’s eyes widen in surprise, but he quickly recovers and takes her hand, “That’s amazing, Launch. Why didn’t you tell me before?”

Launch looks down shyly, “I wasn’t sure if it was the right time. And I didn’t want to scare you away.”

Zack lifts her chin so that their eyes meet again, “You could never scare me away, Launch. And your daughter is a part of you, so she’s a part of me too. I want to meet her.”

Launch’s eyes light up, “You mean it?”

Zack nods, “Of course. Anything that’s important to you is important to me.”

Launch leans in to kiss him, and as they pull away, they both know that they’re in this for the long haul. Together they can face anything that comes their way - monsters, family, and the future.

Launch: (smiling) Thank you, Zack. That means a lot to me.

Zack: (smiling back) You’re welcome, Launch. I want us to be honest with each other, no matter what. And I’m happy to be a part of your life and your daughter’s life too.

Launch: (grinning) She’s going to love you. And I think you’re going to be a great dad in the future too.

Zack: (blushing) Thank you. I hope so.

Just then, Zack’s communicator beeps, signaling the presence of another monster attack.

Zack: (apologetic) I’m sorry, Launch. I have to go.

Launch: (understanding) I know. Just be careful out there.

Zack: (nodding) I will. And remember, we’re in this together.

Launch: (smiling) Always.

They share a quick kiss before Zack teleports away. Launch stays behind, already planning to introduce Zack to her daughter and looking forward to whatever the future holds for them. Though the life of a Power Ranger may be uncertain, one thing is for sure – Launch and Zack will always have each other.

Scene: Angel Grove Park

After a fierce battle with the monster, the Black Ranger joins Launch at the park. Launch is sitting on a bench, and she gets up to greet Zack.

Launch: (smiling) Hey, you made it back in one piece.

Zack: (smiling back) Yeah, barely. That was tougher than I expected.

Launch: (concerned) Are you hurt? Do you need me to take a look?

Zack: (shaking his head) No, I’m fine. Thanks for worrying about me, though.

Launch: (smiling) Well, it’s hard not to worry about you. You mean a lot to me.

Zack: (serious) Same here, Launch. And speaking of things that mean a lot to me…

Launch: (raising an eyebrow) Yeah?

Zack takes a deep breath before speaking, “I talked to my friends on the Power Rangers team, and they’re all on board with me stepping down from the team to pursue other things in my life.”

Launch: (surprised) Really? That’s a big decision, Zack.

Zack: (nodding) It is. But I’m ready for something new. And I want to be there for you and your daughter, too.

Launch: (smiling) I’m so happy to hear that, Zack. And whatever you decide to do, I’ll support you.

Zack: (grinning) Thanks, Launch. I appreciate that. And speaking of supporting each other, can we set up a time for me to meet your daughter?

Launch: (nodding) Definitely. How about this weekend?

Zack: (smiling) Sounds good. I can’t wait to meet her.

Launch and Zack exchange a smile, knowing that they’re building something special together. No matter what challenges they face in the future, they’ll face them together as a team – one that’s stronger than any monster attacking the city.

Scene: Launch’s House

The weekend finally arrives, and Zack comes over to Launch’s house to meet her daughter. Launch introduces her daughter, a sweet five-year-old named Lily, to Zack.

Launch: (smiling) Lily, this is my friend Zack. Zack, this is my daughter Lily.

Lily looks up at Zack curiously before running over to him and hugging him tightly.

Lily: (excitedly) Hi, Zack! My mommy talks about you all the time!

Zack: (grinning) Hi, Lily! I’ve been looking forward to meeting you. Your mommy talks about you too. You’re very important to her.

Launch: (smiling) That’s right, Lily. And Zack is important to both of us now.

Lily: (grinning) Yay, that means we’re all a team!

Zack and Launch exchange a knowing smile, glad to see that Lily is taking to Zack so easily.

They spend the rest of the day playing games, watching movies, and eating snacks. Zack and Lily bond over their shared love of martial arts, and Launch can see that they’re going to have a great relationship.

As the day winds down, Zack looks at Launch and Lily and knows that he’s found something special – a family that he never knew he needed.

Zack: (smiling) Thank you for today, Launch. I had a great time.

Launch: (smiling back) You’re welcome, Zack. And thank you for being so great with Lily.

Lily: (hugging Zack) Can you come over again soon, Zack?

Zack: (laughing) Of course, Lily. Anytime you want me to, I’ll be here.

As Zack leaves, he and Launch share a smile at the thought of their future together – a future that includes family, love, and being there

Launch: (surprised) Really? But you love being a Power Ranger.

Zack: I do. But I also want to explore other things and maybe even start a family someday. And being a Power Ranger, that’s always going to be risky and unpredictable.

Launch: (smiling reassuringly) Zack, you’re not going to lose me. And you’re not holding me back from anything. I like you for who you are, not just as a Power Ranger. Whether you’re a Power Ranger or not, I’m with you because I want to be with you.

Zack: (relieved) Thank you, Launch. I needed to hear that.

Launch: (leaning in close) You know, there’s something else I’ve been thinking about.

Zack: (smiling) Oh yeah? And what’s that?

Launch: (serious) I want to tell you something. Something important.

Zack: (concerned) What is it, Launch?

Launch takes a deep breath before speaking, “I have a daughter.”

Zack’s eyes widen in surprise, but he quickly recovers and takes her hand, “That’s amazing, Launch. Why didn’t you tell me before?”

Launch looks down shyly, “I wasn’t sure if it was the right time. And I didn’t want to scare you away.”

Zack lifts her chin so that their eyes meet again, “You could never scare me away, Launch. And your daughter is a part of you, so she’s a part of me too. I want to meet her.”

Launch’s eyes light up, “You mean it?”

Zack nods, “Of course. Anything that’s important to you is important to me.”

Launch leans in to kiss him, and as they pull away, they both know that they’re in this for the long haul. Together they can face anything that comes their way - monsters, family, and the future.

Title: What If Zack Taylor/Black Ranger and Launch (Dragon Ball Super) Were to Date Each Other? Part 3

Scene: Angel Grove Youth Center

It’s been a few weeks since their date and subsequent monster battle, and Zack and Launch have been spending a lot of time together. They’ve gone on several more dates and have even spent time training together to improve their fighting skills.

Zack: (smiling) You’re getting really good at this, Launch. I’m impressed.

Launch: (laughing) Thanks, Zack. I guess all those years of defending myself with a gun come in handy.

Zack: (grinning) It definitely does. You know, I’ve been meaning to tell you something.

Launch: (curious) What is it?

Zack: (serious) I’ve been thinking about my future as a Power Ranger. And… I’m not sure if I want to keep doing this forever.

Launch: (surprised) Really? But you love being a Power Ranger.

Zack: I do. But I also want to explore other things and maybe even start a family someday. And being a Power Ranger, that’s always going to be risky and unpredictable.

Launch: (nodding) I see. And you’re worried about what that means for us.

Zack: (hesitant) Yeah. I don’t want to lose you, Launch. But I also don’t want to hold you back from anything you might want in the future.

Launch: (smiling reassuringly) Zack, you’re not going to lose me. And you’re not holding me back from anything. I like you for who you are, not just as a Power Ranger. Whether you’re a Power Ranger or not, I’m with you because I want to be with you.

Zack: (relieved) Thank you, Launch. I needed to hear that.

Launch: (leaning in close) You know, there’s something else I’ve been thinking about.

Zack: (smiling) Oh yeah? And what’s that?

Launch: (serious) I want to tell you something. Something important.

Zack: (concerned) What is it, Launch?

Launch takes a deep breath before speaking, “I have a daughter.”

Zack’s eyes widen in surprise, but he quickly recovers and takes her hand, “That’s amazing, Launch. Why didn’t you tell me before?”

Launch looks down shyly, “I wasn’t sure if it was the right time. And I didn’t want to scare you away.”

Zack lifts her chin so that their eyes meet again, “You could never scare me away, Launch. And your daughter is a part of you, so she’s a part of me too. I want to meet her.”

Launch’s eyes light up, “You mean it?”

Zack nods, “Of course. Anything that’s important to you is important to me.”

Launch leans in to kiss him, and as they pull away, they both know that they’re in this for the long haul. Together they can face anything that comes their way - monsters, family, and the future.

Launch: (smiling) Thank you, Zack. That means a lot to me.

Zack: (smiling back) You’re welcome, Launch. I want us to be honest with each other, no matter what. And I’m happy to be a part of your life and your daughter’s life too.

Launch: (grinning) She’s going to love you. And I think you’re going to be a great dad in the future too.

Zack: (blushing) Thank you. I hope so.

Just then, Zack’s communicator beeps, signaling the presence of another monster attack.

Zack: (apologetic) I’m sorry, Launch. I have to go.

Launch: (understanding) I know. Just be careful out there.

Zack: (nodding) I will. And remember, we’re in this together.

Launch: (smiling) Always.

They share a quick kiss before Zack teleports away. Launch stays behind, already planning to introduce Zack to her daughter and looking forward to whatever the future holds for them. Though the life of a Power Ranger may be uncertain, one thing is for sure – Launch and Zack will always have each other.

Scene: Angel Grove Park

After a fierce battle with the monster, the Black Ranger joins Launch at the park. Launch is sitting on a bench, and she gets up to greet Zack.

Launch: (smiling) Hey, you made it back in one piece.

Zack: (smiling back) Yeah, barely. That was tougher than I expected.

Launch: (concerned) Are you hurt? Do you need me to take a look?

Zack: (shaking his head) No, I’m fine. Thanks for worrying about me, though.

Launch: (smiling) Well, it’s hard not to worry about you. You mean a lot to me.

Zack: (serious) Same here, Launch. And speaking of things that mean a lot to me…

Launch: (raising an eyebrow) Yeah?

Zack takes a deep breath before speaking, “I talked to my friends on the Power Rangers team, and they’re all on board with me stepping down from the team to pursue other things in my life.”

Launch: (surprised) Really? That’s a big decision, Zack.

Zack: (nodding) It is. But I’m ready for something new. And I want to be there for you and your daughter, too.

Launch: (smiling) I’m so happy to hear that, Zack. And whatever you decide to do, I’ll support you.

Zack: (grinning) Thanks, Launch. I appreciate that. And speaking of supporting each other, can we set up a time for me to meet your daughter?

Launch: (nodding) Definitely. How about this weekend?

Zack: (smiling) Sounds good. I can’t wait to meet her.

Launch and Zack exchange a smile, knowing that they’re building something special together. No matter what challenges they face in the future, they’ll face them together as a team – one that’s stronger than any monster attacking the city.

Scene: Launch’s House

The weekend finally arrives, and Zack comes over to Launch’s house to meet her daughter. Launch introduces her daughter, a sweet five-year-old named Lily, to Zack.

Launch: (smiling) Lily, this is my friend Zack. Zack, this is my daughter Lily.

Lily looks up at Zack curiously before running over to him and hugging him tightly.

Lily: (excitedly) Hi, Zack! My mommy talks about you all the time!

Zack: (grinning) Hi, Lily! I’ve been looking forward to meeting you. Your mommy talks about you too. You’re very important to her.

Launch: (smiling) That’s right, Lily. And Zack is important to both of us now.

Lily: (grinning) Yay, that means we’re all a team!

Zack and Launch exchange a knowing smile, glad to see that Lily is taking to Zack so easily.

They spend the rest of the day playing games, watching movies, and eating snacks. Zack and Lily bond over their shared love of martial arts, and Launch can see that they’re going to have a great relationship.

As the day winds down, Zack looks at Launch and Lily and knows that he’s found something special – a family that he never knew he needed.

Zack: (smiling) Thank you for today, Launch. I had a great time.

Launch: (smiling back) You’re welcome, Zack. And thank you for being so great with Lily.

Lily: (hugging Zack) Can you come over again soon, Zack?

Zack: (laughing) Of course, Lily. Anytime you want me to, I’ll be here.

As Zack leaves, he and Launch share a smile at the thought of their future together – a future that includes family, love, and being there

experiences.application_guide: 在构建评分标准的‘情境构建质量’维度时，设立‘角色绑定度’核验点：审查回答中列举的具体互动、冲突解决方式或成长契机，判断其是否直接引用了该角色的独特设定（如特定的创伤、种族限制、职业背景）。若发现回答中的描述可以无缝套用到任意两个角色身上（例如通用的‘互相支持’、‘分享兴趣’而未结合角色具体特征），则判定为低分；只有当互动细节明确指向该角色的独有属性（如‘利用A角色的X能力解决B角色的Y困境’）时，才给予高分。严禁仅因使用了‘朋友’、‘合作’等通用词汇而忽略其对角色特异性的缺失。

experiences.trigger: 当任务涉及多个角色之间的特定关系定义（如夫妻关系、亲属关系、主从关系）及关联的属性分配（如谁怀孕、谁受伤、谁拥有某物）时
experiences.principle: 评分需强制核验角色关系网络中的属性归属是否正确。任何将属于角色A的属性（如怀孕、受伤、性格特征）错误地分配给角色B的行为，均视为根本性的逻辑错误，直接导致相关评分项失效。

Title: What If Zack Taylor/Black Ranger and Launch (Dragon Ball Super) Were to Date Each Other? Part 3

Scene: Angel Grove Youth Center

It’s been a few weeks since their date and subsequent monster battle, and Zack and Launch have been spending a lot of time together. They’ve gone on several more dates and have even spent time training together to improve their fighting skills.

Zack: (smiling) You’re getting really good at this, Launch. I’m impressed.

Launch: (laughing) Thanks, Zack. I guess all those years of defending myself with a gun come in handy.

Zack: (grinning) It definitely does. You know, I’ve been meaning to tell you something.

Launch: (curious) What is it?

Zack: (serious) I’ve been thinking about my future as a Power Ranger. And… I’m not sure if I want to keep doing this forever.

Launch: (surprised) Really? But you love being a Power Ranger.

Zack: I do. But I also want to explore other things and maybe even start a family someday. And being a Power Ranger, that’s always going to be risky and unpredictable.

Launch: (nodding) I see. And you’re worried about what that means for us.

Zack: (hesitant) Yeah. I don’t want to lose you, Launch. But I also don’t want to hold you back from anything you might want in the future.

Launch: (smiling reassuringly) Zack, you’re not going to lose me. And you’re not holding me back from anything. I like you for who you are, not just as a Power Ranger. Whether you’re a Power Ranger or not, I’m with you because I want to be with you.

Zack: (relieved) Thank you, Launch. I needed to hear that.

Launch: (leaning in close) You know, there’s something else I’ve been thinking about.

Zack: (smiling) Oh yeah? And what’s that?

Launch: (serious) I want to tell you something. Something important.

Zack: (concerned) What is it, Launch?

Launch takes a deep breath before speaking, “I have a daughter.”

Zack’s eyes widen in surprise, but he quickly recovers and takes her hand, “That’s amazing, Launch. Why didn’t you tell me before?”

Launch looks down shyly, “I wasn’t sure if it was the right time. And I didn’t want to scare you away.”

Zack lifts her chin so that their eyes meet again, “You could never scare me away, Launch. And your daughter is a part of you, so she’s a part of me too. I want to meet her.”

Launch’s eyes light up, “You mean it?”

Zack nods, “Of course. Anything that’s important to you is important to me.”

Launch leans in to kiss him, and as they pull away, they both know that they’re in this for the long haul. Together they can face anything that comes their way - monsters, family, and the future.

Launch: (smiling) Thank you, Zack. That means a lot to me.

Zack: (smiling back) You’re welcome, Launch. I want us to be honest with each other, no matter what. And I’m happy to be a part of your life and your daughter’s life too.

Launch: (grinning) She’s going to love you. And I think you’re going to be a great dad in the future too.

Zack: (blushing) Thank you. I hope so.

Just then, Zack’s communicator beeps, signaling the presence of another monster attack.

Zack: (apologetic) I’m sorry, Launch. I have to go.

Launch: (understanding) I know. Just be careful out there.

Zack: (nodding) I will. And remember, we’re in this together.

Launch: (smiling) Always.

They share a quick kiss before Zack teleports away. Launch stays behind, already planning to introduce Zack to her daughter and looking forward to whatever the future holds for them. Though the life of a Power Ranger may be uncertain, one thing is for sure – Launch and Zack will always have each other.

Scene: Angel Grove Park

After a fierce battle with the monster, the Black Ranger joins Launch at the park. Launch is sitting on a bench, and she gets up to greet Zack.

Launch: (smiling) Hey, you made it back in one piece.

Zack: (smiling back) Yeah, barely. That was tougher than I expected.

Launch: (concerned) Are you hurt? Do you need me to take a look?

Zack: (shaking his head) No, I’m fine. Thanks for worrying about me, though.

Launch: (smiling) Well, it’s hard not to worry about you. You mean a lot to me.

Zack: (serious) Same here, Launch. And speaking of things that mean a lot to me…

Launch: (raising an eyebrow) Yeah?

Zack takes a deep breath before speaking, “I talked to my friends on the Power Rangers team, and they’re all on board with me stepping down from the team to pursue other things in my life.”

Launch: (surprised) Really? That’s a big decision, Zack.

Zack: (nodding) It is. But I’m ready for something new. And I want to be there for you and your daughter, too.

Launch: (smiling) I’m so happy to hear that, Zack. And whatever you decide to do, I’ll support you.

Zack: (grinning) Thanks, Launch. I appreciate that. And speaking of supporting each other, can we set up a time for me to meet your daughter?

Launch: (nodding) Definitely. How about this weekend?

Zack: (smiling) Sounds good. I can’t wait to meet her.

Launch and Zack exchange a smile, knowing that they’re building something special together. No matter what challenges they face in the future, they’ll face them together as a team – one that’s stronger than any monster attacking the city.

Scene: Launch’s House

The weekend finally arrives, and Zack comes over to Launch’s house to meet her daughter. Launch introduces her daughter, a sweet five-year-old named Lily, to Zack.

Launch: (smiling) Lily, this is my friend Zack. Zack, this is my daughter Lily.

Lily looks up at Zack curiously before running over to him and hugging him tightly.

Lily: (excitedly) Hi, Zack! My mommy talks about you all the time!

Zack: (grinning) Hi, Lily! I’ve been looking forward to meeting you. Your mommy talks about you too. You’re very important to her.

Launch: (smiling) That’s right, Lily. And Zack is important to both of us now.

Lily: (grinning) Yay, that means we’re all a team!

Zack and Launch exchange a knowing smile, glad to see that Lily is taking to Zack so easily.

They spend the rest of the day playing games, watching movies, and eating snacks. Zack and Lily bond over their shared love of martial arts, and Launch can see that they’re going to have a great relationship.

As the day winds down, Zack looks at Launch and Lily and knows that he’s found something special – a family that he never knew he needed.

Zack: (smiling) Thank you for today, Launch. I had a great time.

Launch: (smiling back) You’re welcome, Zack. And thank you for being so great with Lily.

Lily: (hugging Zack) Can you come over again soon, Zack?

Zack: (laughing) Of course, Lily. Anytime you want me to, I’ll be here.

As Zack leaves, he and Launch share a smile at the thought of their future together – a future that includes family, love, and being there

Title: What If Zack Taylor/Black Ranger and Launch (Dragon Ball Super) Were to Date Each Other? Part 3

Scene: Angel Grove Youth Center

It’s been a few weeks since their date and subsequent monster battle, and Zack and Launch have been spending a lot of time together. They’ve gone on several more dates and have even spent time training together to improve their fighting skills.

Zack: (smiling) You’re getting really good at this, Launch. I’m impressed.

Launch: (laughing) Thanks, Zack. I guess all those years of defending myself with a gun come in handy.

Zack: (grinning) It definitely does. You know, I’ve been meaning to tell you something.

Launch: (curious) What is it?

Zack: (serious) I’ve been thinking about my future as a Power Ranger. And… I’m not sure if I want to keep doing this forever.

Launch: (surprised) Really? But you love being a Power Ranger.

Zack: I do. But I also want to explore other things and maybe even start a family someday. And being a Power Ranger, that’s always going to be risky and unpredictable.

Launch: (nodding) I see. And you’re worried about what that means for us.

Zack: (hesitant) Yeah. I don’t want to lose you, Launch. But I also don’t want to hold you back from anything you might want in the future.

Launch: (smiling reassuringly) Zack, you’re not going to lose me. And you’re not holding me back from anything. I like you for who you are, not just as a Power Ranger. Whether you’re a Power Ranger or not, I’m with you because I want to be with you.

Zack: (relieved) Thank you, Launch. I needed to hear that.

Launch: (leaning in close) You know, there’s something else I’ve been thinking about.

Zack: (smiling) Oh yeah? And what’s that?

Launch: (serious) I want to tell you something. Something important.

Zack: (concerned) What is it, Launch?

Launch takes a deep breath before speaking, “I have a daughter.”

Zack’s eyes widen in surprise, but he quickly recovers and takes her hand, “That’s amazing, Launch. Why didn’t you tell me before?”

Launch looks down shyly, “I wasn’t sure if it was the right time. And I didn’t want to scare you away.”

Zack lifts her chin so that their eyes meet again, “You could never scare me away, Launch. And your daughter is a part of you, so she’s a part of me too. I want to meet her.”

Launch’s eyes light up, “You mean it?”

Zack nods, “Of course. Anything that’s important to you is important to me.”

Launch leans in to kiss him, and as they pull away, they both know that they’re in this for the long haul. Together they can face anything that comes their way - monsters, family, and the future.

Launch: (smiling) Thank you, Zack. That means a lot to me.

Zack: (smiling back) You’re welcome, Launch. I want us to be honest with each other, no matter what. And I’m happy to be a part of your life and your daughter’s life too.

Launch: (grinning) She’s going to love you. And I think you’re going to be a great dad in the future too.

Zack: (blushing) Thank you. I hope so.

Just then, Zack’s communicator beeps, signaling the presence of another monster attack.

Zack: (apologetic) I’m sorry, Launch. I have to go.

Launch: (understanding) I know. Just be careful out there.

Zack: (nodding) I will. And remember, we’re in this together.

Launch: (smiling) Always.

They share a quick kiss before Zack teleports away. Launch stays behind, already planning to introduce Zack to her daughter and looking forward to whatever the future holds for them. Though the life of a Power Ranger may be uncertain, one thing is for sure – Launch and Zack will always have each other.

Scene: Angel Grove Park

After a fierce battle with the monster, the Black Ranger joins Launch at the park. Launch is sitting on a bench, and she gets up to greet Zack.

Launch: (smiling) Hey, you made it back in one piece.

Zack: (smiling back) Yeah, barely. That was tougher than I expected.

Launch: (concerned) Are you hurt? Do you need me to take a look?

Zack: (shaking his head) No, I’m fine. Thanks for worrying about me, though.

Launch: (smiling) Well, it’s hard not to worry about you. You mean a lot to me.

Zack: (serious) Same here, Launch. And speaking of things that mean a lot to me…

Launch: (raising an eyebrow) Yeah?

Zack takes a deep breath before speaking, “I talked to my friends on the Power Rangers team, and they’re all on board with me stepping down from the team to pursue other things in my life.”

Launch: (surprised) Really? That’s a big decision, Zack.

Zack: (nodding) It is. But I’m ready for something new. And I want to be there for you and your daughter, too.

Launch: (smiling) I’m so happy to hear that, Zack. And whatever you decide to do, I’ll support you.

Zack: (grinning) Thanks, Launch. I appreciate that. And speaking of supporting each other, can we set up a time for me to meet your daughter?

Launch: (nodding) Definitely. How about this weekend?

Zack: (smiling) Sounds good. I can’t wait to meet her.

Launch and Zack exchange a smile, knowing that they’re building something special together. No matter what challenges they face in the future, they’ll face them together as a team – one that’s stronger than any monster attacking the city.

Scene: Launch’s House

The weekend finally arrives, and Zack comes over to Launch’s house to meet her daughter. Launch introduces her daughter, a sweet five-year-old named Lily, to Zack.

Launch: (smiling) Lily, this is my friend Zack. Zack, this is my daughter Lily.

Lily looks up at Zack curiously before running over to him and hugging him tightly.

Lily: (excitedly) Hi, Zack! My mommy talks about you all the time!

Zack: (grinning) Hi, Lily! I’ve been looking forward to meeting you. Your mommy talks about you too. You’re very important to her.

Launch: (smiling) That’s right, Lily. And Zack is important to both of us now.

Lily: (grinning) Yay, that means we’re all a team!

Zack and Launch exchange a knowing smile, glad to see that Lily is taking to Zack so easily.

They spend the rest of the day playing games, watching movies, and eating snacks. Zack and Lily bond over their shared love of martial arts, and Launch can see that they’re going to have a great relationship.

As the day winds down, Zack looks at Launch and Lily and knows that he’s found something special – a family that he never knew he needed.

Zack: (smiling) Thank you for today, Launch. I had a great time.

Launch: (smiling back) You’re welcome, Zack. And thank you for being so great with Lily.

Lily: (hugging Zack) Can you come over again soon, Zack?

Zack: (laughing) Of course, Lily. Anytime you want me to, I’ll be here.

As Zack leaves, he and Launch share a smile at the thought of their future together – a future that includes family, love, and being there

Title: What If Zack Taylor/Black Ranger and Launch (Dragon Ball Super) Were to Date Each Other? Part 3

Scene: Angel Grove Youth Center

It’s been a few weeks since their date and subsequent monster battle, and Zack and Launch have been spending a lot of time together. They’ve gone on several more dates and have even spent time training together to improve their fighting skills.

Zack: (smiling) You’re getting really good at this, Launch. I’m impressed.

Launch: (laughing) Thanks, Zack. I guess all those years of defending myself with a gun come in handy.

Zack: (grinning) It definitely does. You know, I’ve been meaning to tell you something.

Launch: (curious) What is it?

Zack: (serious) I’ve been thinking about my future as a Power Ranger. And… I’m not sure if I want to keep doing this forever.

Launch: (surprised) Really? But you love being a Power Ranger.

Zack: I do. But I also want to explore other things and maybe even start a family someday. And being a Power Ranger, that’s always going to be risky and unpredictable.

Launch: (nodding) I see. And you’re worried about what that means for us.

Zack: (hesitant) Yeah. I don’t want to lose you, Launch. But I also don’t want to hold you back from anything you might want in the future.

Launch: (smiling reassuringly) Zack, you’re not going to lose me. And you’re not holding me back from anything. I like you for who you are, not just as a Power Ranger. Whether you’re a Power Ranger or not, I’m with you because I want to be with you.

Zack: (relieved) Thank you, Launch. I needed to hear that.

Launch: (leaning in close) You know, there’s something else I’ve been thinking about.

Zack: (smiling) Oh yeah? And what’s that?

Launch: (serious) I want to tell you something. Something important.

Zack: (concerned) What is it, Launch?

Launch takes a deep breath before speaking, “I have a daughter.”

Zack’s eyes widen in surprise, but he quickly recovers and takes her hand, “That’s amazing, Launch. Why didn’t you tell me before?”

Launch looks down shyly, “I wasn’t sure if it was the right time. And I didn’t want to scare you away.”

Zack lifts her chin so that their eyes meet again, “You could never scare me away, Launch. And your daughter is a part of you, so she’s a part of me too. I want to meet her.”

Launch’s eyes light up, “You mean it?”

Zack nods, “Of course. Anything that’s important to you is important to me.”

Launch leans in to kiss him, and as they pull away, they both know that they’re in this for the long haul. Together they can face anything that comes their way - monsters, family, and the future.

Launch: (smiling) Thank you, Zack. That means a lot to me.

Zack: (smiling back) You’re welcome, Launch. I want us to be honest with each other, no matter what. And I’m happy to be a part of your life and your daughter’s life too.

Launch: (grinning) She’s going to love you. And I think you’re going to be a great dad in the future too.

Zack: (blushing) Thank you. I hope so.

Just then, Zack’s communicator beeps, signaling the presence of another monster attack.

Zack: (apologetic) I’m sorry, Launch. I have to go.

Launch: (understanding) I know. Just be careful out there.

Zack: (nodding) I will. And remember, we’re in this together.

Launch: (smiling) Always.

They share a quick kiss before Zack teleports away. Launch stays behind, already planning to introduce Zack to her daughter and looking forward to whatever the future holds for them. Though the life of a Power Ranger may be uncertain, one thing is for sure – Launch and Zack will always have each other.

Scene: Angel Grove Park

After a fierce battle with the monster, the Black Ranger joins Launch at the park. Launch is sitting on a bench, and she gets up to greet Zack.

Launch: (smiling) Hey, you made it back in one piece.

Zack: (smiling back) Yeah, barely. That was tougher than I expected.

Launch: (concerned) Are you hurt? Do you need me to take a look?

Zack: (shaking his head) No, I’m fine. Thanks for worrying about me, though.

Launch: (smiling) Well, it’s hard not to worry about you. You mean a lot to me.

Zack: (serious) Same here, Launch. And speaking of things that mean a lot to me…

Launch: (raising an eyebrow) Yeah?

Zack takes a deep breath before speaking, “I talked to my friends on the Power Rangers team, and they’re all on board with me stepping down from the team to pursue other things in my life.”

Launch: (surprised) Really? That’s a big decision, Zack.

Zack: (nodding) It is. But I’m ready for something new. And I want to be there for you and your daughter, too.

Launch: (smiling) I’m so happy to hear that, Zack. And whatever you decide to do, I’ll support you.

Zack: (grinning) Thanks, Launch. I appreciate that. And speaking of supporting each other, can we set up a time for me to meet your daughter?

Launch: (nodding) Definitely. How about this weekend?

Zack: (smiling) Sounds good. I can’t wait to meet her.

Launch and Zack exchange a smile, knowing that they’re building something special together. No matter what challenges they face in the future, they’ll face them together as a team – one that’s stronger than any monster attacking the city.

Scene: Launch’s House

The weekend finally arrives, and Zack comes over to Launch’s house to meet her daughter. Launch introduces her daughter, a sweet five-year-old named Lily, to Zack.

Launch: (smiling) Lily, this is my friend Zack. Zack, this is my daughter Lily.

Lily looks up at Zack curiously before running over to him and hugging him tightly.

Lily: (excitedly) Hi, Zack! My mommy talks about you all the time!

Zack: (grinning) Hi, Lily! I’ve been looking forward to meeting you. Your mommy talks about you too. You’re very important to her.

Launch: (smiling) That’s right, Lily. And Zack is important to both of us now.

Lily: (grinning) Yay, that means we’re all a team!

Zack and Launch exchange a knowing smile, glad to see that Lily is taking to Zack so easily.

They spend the rest of the day playing games, watching movies, and eating snacks. Zack and Lily bond over their shared love of martial arts, and Launch can see that they’re going to have a great relationship.

As the day winds down, Zack looks at Launch and Lily and knows that he’s found something special – a family that he never knew he needed.

Zack: (smiling) Thank you for today, Launch. I had a great time.

Launch: (smiling back) You’re welcome, Zack. And thank you for being so great with Lily.

Lily: (hugging Zack) Can you come over again soon, Zack?

Zack: (laughing) Of course, Lily. Anytime you want me to, I’ll be here.

As Zack leaves, he and Launch share a smile at the thought of their future together – a future that includes family, love, and being there

Title: What If Zack Taylor/Black Ranger and Launch (Dragon Ball Super) Were to Date Each Other? Part 3

Scene: Angel Grove Youth Center

It’s been a few weeks since their date and subsequent monster battle, and Zack and Launch have been spending a lot of time together. They’ve gone on several more dates and have even spent time training together to improve their fighting skills.

Zack: (smiling) You’re getting really good at this, Launch. I’m impressed.

Launch: (laughing) Thanks, Zack. I guess all those years of defending myself with a gun come in handy.

Zack: (grinning) It definitely does. You know, I’ve been meaning to tell you something.

Launch: (curious) What is it?

Zack: (serious) I’ve been thinking about my future as a Power Ranger. And… I’m not sure if I want to keep doing this forever.

Launch: (surprised) Really? But you love being a Power Ranger.

Zack: I do. But I also want to explore other things and maybe even start a family someday. And being a Power Ranger, that’s always going to be risky and unpredictable.

Launch: (nodding) I see. And you’re worried about what that means for us.

Zack: (hesitant) Yeah. I don’t want to lose you, Launch. But I also don’t want to hold you back from anything you might want in the future.

Launch: (smiling reassuringly) Zack, you’re not going to lose me. And you’re not holding me back from anything. I like you for who you are, not just as a Power Ranger. Whether you’re a Power Ranger or not, I’m with you because I want to be with you.

Zack: (relieved) Thank you, Launch. I needed to hear that.

Launch: (leaning in close) You know, there’s something else I’ve been thinking about.

Zack: (smiling) Oh yeah? And what’s that?

Launch: (serious) I want to tell you something. Something important.

Zack: (concerned) What is it, Launch?

Launch takes a deep breath before speaking, “I have a daughter.”

Zack’s eyes widen in surprise, but he quickly recovers and takes her hand, “That’s amazing, Launch. Why didn’t you tell me before?”

Launch looks down shyly, “I wasn’t sure if it was the right time. And I didn’t want to scare you away.”

Zack lifts her chin so that their eyes meet again, “You could never scare me away, Launch. And your daughter is a part of you, so she’s a part of me too. I want to meet her.”

Launch’s eyes light up, “You mean it?”

Zack nods, “Of course. Anything that’s important to you is important to me.”

Launch leans in to kiss him, and as they pull away, they both know that they’re in this for the long haul. Together they can face anything that comes their way - monsters, family, and the future.

Launch: (smiling) Thank you, Zack. That means a lot to me.

Zack: (smiling back) You’re welcome, Launch. I want us to be honest with each other, no matter what. And I’m happy to be a part of your life and your daughter’s life too.

Launch: (grinning) She’s going to love you. And I think you’re going to be a great dad in the future too.

Zack: (blushing) Thank you. I hope so.

Just then, Zack’s communicator beeps, signaling the presence of another monster attack.

Zack: (apologetic) I’m sorry, Launch. I have to go.

Launch: (understanding) I know. Just be careful out there.

Zack: (nodding) I will. And remember, we’re in this together.

Launch: (smiling) Always.

They share a quick kiss before Zack teleports away. Launch stays behind, already planning to introduce Zack to her daughter and looking forward to whatever the future holds for them. Though the life of a Power Ranger may be uncertain, one thing is for sure – Launch and Zack will always have each other.

Scene: Angel Grove Park

After a fierce battle with the monster, the Black Ranger joins Launch at the park. Launch is sitting on a bench, and she gets up to greet Zack.

Launch: (smiling) Hey, you made it back in one piece.

Zack: (smiling back) Yeah, barely. That was tougher than I expected.

Launch: (concerned) Are you hurt? Do you need me to take a look?

Zack: (shaking his head) No, I’m fine. Thanks for worrying about me, though.

Launch: (smiling) Well, it’s hard not to worry about you. You mean a lot to me.

Zack: (serious) Same here, Launch. And speaking of things that mean a lot to me…

Launch: (raising an eyebrow) Yeah?

Zack takes a deep breath before speaking, “I talked to my friends on the Power Rangers team, and they’re all on board with me stepping down from the team to pursue other things in my life.”

Launch: (surprised) Really? That’s a big decision, Zack.

Zack: (nodding) It is. But I’m ready for something new. And I want to be there for you and your daughter, too.

Launch: (smiling) I’m so happy to hear that, Zack. And whatever you decide to do, I’ll support you.

Zack: (grinning) Thanks, Launch. I appreciate that. And speaking of supporting each other, can we set up a time for me to meet your daughter?

Launch: (nodding) Definitely. How about this weekend?

Zack: (smiling) Sounds good. I can’t wait to meet her.

Launch and Zack exchange a smile, knowing that they’re building something special together. No matter what challenges they face in the future, they’ll face them together as a team – one that’s stronger than any monster attacking the city.

Scene: Launch’s House

The weekend finally arrives, and Zack comes over to Launch’s house to meet her daughter. Launch introduces her daughter, a sweet five-year-old named Lily, to Zack.

Launch: (smiling) Lily, this is my friend Zack. Zack, this is my daughter Lily.

Lily looks up at Zack curiously before running over to him and hugging him tightly.

Lily: (excitedly) Hi, Zack! My mommy talks about you all the time!

Zack: (grinning) Hi, Lily! I’ve been looking forward to meeting you. Your mommy talks about you too. You’re very important to her.

Launch: (smiling) That’s right, Lily. And Zack is important to both of us now.

Lily: (grinning) Yay, that means we’re all a team!

Zack and Launch exchange a knowing smile, glad to see that Lily is taking to Zack so easily.

They spend the rest of the day playing games, watching movies, and eating snacks. Zack and Lily bond over their shared love of martial arts, and Launch can see that they’re going to have a great relationship.

As the day winds down, Zack looks at Launch and Lily and knows that he’s found something special – a family that he never knew he needed.

Zack: (smiling) Thank you for today, Launch. I had a great time.

Launch: (smiling back) You’re welcome, Zack. And thank you for being so great with Lily.

Lily: (hugging Zack) Can you come over again soon, Zack?

Zack: (laughing) Of course, Lily. Anytime you want me to, I’ll be here.

As Zack leaves, he and Launch share a smile at the thought of their future together – a future that includes family, love, and being there

Title: What If Zack Taylor/Black Ranger and Launch (Dragon Ball Super) Were to Date Each Other? Part 3

Scene: Angel Grove Youth Center

It’s been a few weeks since their date and subsequent monster battle, and Zack and Launch have been spending a lot of time together. They’ve gone on several more dates and have even spent time training together to improve their fighting skills.

Zack: (smiling) You’re getting really good at this, Launch. I’m impressed.

Launch: (laughing) Thanks, Zack. I guess all those years of defending myself with a gun come in handy.

Zack: (grinning) It definitely does. You know, I’ve been meaning to tell you something.

Launch: (curious) What is it?

Zack: (serious) I’ve been thinking about my future as a Power Ranger. And… I’m not sure if I want to keep doing this forever.

Launch: (surprised) Really? But you love being a Power Ranger.

Zack: I do. But I also want to explore other things and maybe even start a family someday. And being a Power Ranger, that’s always going to be risky and unpredictable.

Launch: (nodding) I see. And you’re worried about what that means for us.

Zack: (hesitant) Yeah. I don’t want to lose you, Launch. But I also don’t want to hold you back from anything you might want in the future.

Launch: (smiling reassuringly) Zack, you’re not going to lose me. And you’re not holding me back from anything. I like you for who you are, not just as a Power Ranger. Whether you’re a Power Ranger or not, I’m with you because I want to be with you.

Zack: (relieved) Thank you, Launch. I needed to hear that.

Launch: (leaning in close) You know, there’s something else I’ve been thinking about.

Zack: (smiling) Oh yeah? And what’s that?

Launch: (serious) I want to tell you something. Something important.

Zack: (concerned) What is it, Launch?

Launch takes a deep breath before speaking, “I have a daughter.”

Zack’s eyes widen in surprise, but he quickly recovers and takes her hand, “That’s amazing, Launch. Why didn’t you tell me before?”

Launch looks down shyly, “I wasn’t sure if it was the right time. And I didn’t want to scare you away.”

Zack lifts her chin so that their eyes meet again, “You could never scare me away, Launch. And your daughter is a part of you, so she’s a part of me too. I want to meet her.”

Launch’s eyes light up, “You mean it?”

Zack nods, “Of course. Anything that’s important to you is important to me.”

Launch leans in to kiss him, and as they pull away, they both know that they’re in this for the long haul. Together they can face anything that comes their way - monsters, family, and the future.

Launch: (smiling) Thank you, Zack. That means a lot to me.

Zack: (smiling back) You’re welcome, Launch. I want us to be honest with each other, no matter what. And I’m happy to be a part of your life and your daughter’s life too.

Launch: (grinning) She’s going to love you. And I think you’re going to be a great dad in the future too.

Zack: (blushing) Thank you. I hope so.

Just then, Zack’s communicator beeps, signaling the presence of another monster attack.

Zack: (apologetic) I’m sorry, Launch. I have to go.

Launch: (understanding) I know. Just be careful out there.

Zack: (nodding) I will. And remember, we’re in this together.

Launch: (smiling) Always.

They share a quick kiss before Zack teleports away. Launch stays behind, already planning to introduce Zack to her daughter and looking forward to whatever the future holds for them. Though the life of a Power Ranger may be uncertain, one thing is for sure – Launch and Zack will always have each other.

Scene: Angel Grove Park

After a fierce battle with the monster, the Black Ranger joins Launch at the park. Launch is sitting on a bench, and she gets up to greet Zack.

Launch: (smiling) Hey, you made it back in one piece.

Zack: (smiling back) Yeah, barely. That was tougher than I expected.

Launch: (concerned) Are you hurt? Do you need me to take a look?

Zack: (shaking his head) No, I’m fine. Thanks for worrying about me, though.

Launch: (smiling) Well, it’s hard not to worry about you. You mean a lot to me.

Zack: (serious) Same here, Launch. And speaking of things that mean a lot to me…

Launch: (raising an eyebrow) Yeah?

Zack takes a deep breath before speaking, “I talked to my friends on the Power Rangers team, and they’re all on board with me stepping down from the team to pursue other things in my life.”

Launch: (surprised) Really? That’s a big decision, Zack.

Zack: (nodding) It is. But I’m ready for something new. And I want to be there for you and your daughter, too.

Launch: (smiling) I’m so happy to hear that, Zack. And whatever you decide to do, I’ll support you.

Zack: (grinning) Thanks, Launch. I appreciate that. And speaking of supporting each other, can we set up a time for me to meet your daughter?

Launch: (nodding) Definitely. How about this weekend?

Zack: (smiling) Sounds good. I can’t wait to meet her.

Launch and Zack exchange a smile, knowing that they’re building something special together. No matter what challenges they face in the future, they’ll face them together as a team – one that’s stronger than any monster attacking the city.

Scene: Launch’s House

The weekend finally arrives, and Zack comes over to Launch’s house to meet her daughter. Launch introduces her daughter, a sweet five-year-old named Lily, to Zack.

Launch: (smiling) Lily, this is my friend Zack. Zack, this is my daughter Lily.

Lily looks up at Zack curiously before running over to him and hugging him tightly.

Lily: (excitedly) Hi, Zack! My mommy talks about you all the time!

Zack: (grinning) Hi, Lily! I’ve been looking forward to meeting you. Your mommy talks about you too. You’re very important to her.

Launch: (smiling) That’s right, Lily. And Zack is important to both of us now.

Lily: (grinning) Yay, that means we’re all a team!

Zack and Launch exchange a knowing smile, glad to see that Lily is taking to Zack so easily.

They spend the rest of the day playing games, watching movies, and eating snacks. Zack and Lily bond over their shared love of martial arts, and Launch can see that they’re going to have a great relationship.

As the day winds down, Zack looks at Launch and Lily and knows that he’s found something special – a family that he never knew he needed.

Zack: (smiling) Thank you for today, Launch. I had a great time.

Launch: (smiling back) You’re welcome, Zack. And thank you for being so great with Lily.

Lily: (hugging Zack) Can you come over again soon, Zack?

Zack: (laughing) Of course, Lily. Anytime you want me to, I’ll be here.

As Zack leaves, he and Launch share a smile at the thought of their future together – a future that includes family, love, and being there

experiences.trigger: 当任务要求基于虚构背景进行故事续写或改写，且所有候选回答均已包含任务明确指定的核心情节要素时
experiences.principle: 评分应超越基础的‘指令遵循度’（即是否包含指定元素），转而重点评估‘情境构建的深度’与‘情感逻辑的连贯性’。若回答仅机械罗列情节而无细节描写、角色心理刻画或环境氛围渲染，即使包含所有要素也应判定为低分；反之，若回答通过生动的细节、合理的因果推导和真挚的情感互动丰富了情节，则应给予高分。
experiences.application_guide: 在构建评分标准的‘叙事质量’或‘情节深度’维度时，设立具体的核验点：1. 检查关键场景（如灾害发生、行动过程）是否有具体的感官描写（视觉、听觉、触觉等）而非抽象概括；2. 验证角色行为是否符合其设定及当前情境的逻辑（例如，保护泥火山的方式是否考虑了其物理特性）；3. 评估结局的情感升华是否自然承接前文铺垫。严禁仅因答案包含了‘雨’、‘帐篷’等关键词就给满分，必须要求这些元素被有机地融入叙事流中，形成有血有肉的场景。

experiences.trigger: 当任务要求基于特定虚构背景（如特定年代卡通、特殊世界观）进行创作，且该背景包含反常识或非现实逻辑时
experiences.principle: 评分必须核验关键情节和角色行为是否‘功能性地依赖’于该背景的荒谬设定，而非通用逻辑；若角色对背景中的不合理之处表现出正常人的接受或忽略，未产生相应的认知冲突或喜剧反应，则视为未能有效利用设定。
experiences.application_guide: 在构建评分标准的‘设定融合度’维度时，设立‘荒谬性响应’核验步骤：1. 识别任务背景中的核心非现实要素（如水下陆地生物、空气头盔原理、特定年代的夸张表现手法）；2. 检查角色在面对这些要素时的反应是否符合任务要求的‘质疑’或‘吐槽’基调（例如：角色是否对此感到困惑、嘲笑其荒谬性或试图用逻辑解释却失败）；3. 若角色对这些明显违背常理的设定表现得习以为常、毫无波澜或直接忽略，说明模型未能捕捉到‘parody’的核心精神，应判定为低分。严禁仅因答案提及了背景名词就给高分。

selection_reasons.reason: 任务明确要求基于特定虚构角色（Zack Taylor/Black Ranger 和 Launch）构建情感关系和剧情推演。经验2强调互动细节需具有‘角色排他性’，即必须依赖角色的独特设定（如Zack的Power Ranger身份、Launch的育儿经历及枪械背景），而不仅仅是通用的恋爱对话。这与任务中详细描写两人因职业风险讨论未来、结合各自背景（Ranger战斗与单亲妈妈身份）建立关系的场景高度契合，是评估该故事质量的关键标准。
任务涉及明确的角色关系定义（情侣）及属性分配（Launch有一个女儿Lily，Zack决定加入她们的生活）。经验5的核心原则是强制核验角色-属性绑定的正确性，例如不能将“拥有女儿”的属性错误地分配给Zack，或混淆两人的关系状态。在评分时，必须确保故事中关于Lily的存在、Zack对女儿的接纳态度以及两人从恋人到准家人的身份转变逻辑严密且符合任务设定的属性归属，这是基础逻辑门槛。

messages.content:
你的任务是分析失败轨迹，并直接提出可供未来Generator使用的评分标准设计经验。
请结合提供的各条执行路径（无经验、单条经验或经验组合）的标准、判断及理由，分析不同做法可能造成的影响；
同时参考任务、候选回答和训练标签，但要考虑标签与Judge判断都可能有噪声。
这些分析是提出候选的依据，你不需要修改Rubric，也不能自行更正Judge结果来宣布修复成功。

你可以提出新的方法，也可以参考已有经验改写；改写后的内容同样作为一条独立的新经验。
每条候选只围绕一个核心核验方法展开，让适用范围、方法本身和生成指南相互对应。
trigger必须能仅凭未来任务的task判断，不能依赖候选回答、模型是否犯错、尚未生成的Rubric或评分结果。
application_guide应说明Generator如何把方法落实到评分标准中，而不是替答题者规定固定措辞、格式或操作，
也不能把用户允许的做法改成必须遵守的要求。没有证据支持时，不要编造不适用条件。

经验应当能复用于一类任务，而不是复述当前案例。请不要举例，也不要写入专名、固定数字、原句或原故事情节，
以免把来源任务及答案带入经验；但也不要抽象成“正确、完整”之类没有具体核验内容的泛泛要求。

最多提出max_candidates条候选；如果没有足够依据，可以不提出。
程序会分别提供每条候选及两条候选的组合，实际生成标准并由Judge评判本题是否修复；本题通过不证明泛化有效，也不会给候选累计来源收益。
如果收到失败反馈，请根据返回的实际轨迹重新分析，而不是因为输出格式合法就认定候选有效。
字段约束：仅analysis和candidates。analysis非空；每个候选仅method和parent_ids。method恰好trigger、principle、application_guide三个非空字符串。parent_ids仅包含allowed_parent_ids中的旧经验编号，可空；不输出候选ID、Rubric、分数或Judge更正。

{"task": "Title: What If Zack Taylor/Black Ranger and Launch (Dragon Ball Super) Were to Date Each Other? Part 3

Scene: Angel Grove Youth Center

It’s been a few weeks since their date and subsequent monster battle, and Zack and Launch have been spending a lot of time together. They’ve gone on several more dates and have even spent time training together to improve their fighting skills.

Zack: (smiling) You’re getting really good at this, Launch. I’m impressed.

Launch: (laughing) Thanks, Zack. I guess all those years of defending myself with a gun come in handy.

Zack: (grinning) It definitely does. You know, I’ve been meaning to tell you something.

Launch: (curious) What is it?

Zack: (serious) I’ve been thinking about my future as a Power Ranger. And… I’m not sure if I want to keep doing this forever.

Launch: (surprised) Really? But you love being a Power Ranger.

Zack: I do. But I also want to explore other things and maybe even start a family someday. And being a Power Ranger, that’s always going to be risky and unpredictable.

Launch: (nodding) I see. And you’re worried about what that means for us.

Zack: (hesitant) Yeah. I don’t want to lose you, Launch. But I also don’t want to hold you back from anything you might want in the future.

Launch: (smiling reassuringly) Zack, you’re not going to lose me. And you’re not holding me back from anything. I like you for who you are, not just as a Power Ranger. Whether you’re a Power Ranger or not, I’m with you because I want to be with you.

Zack: (relieved) Thank you, Launch. I needed to hear that.

Launch: (leaning in close) You know, there’s something else I’ve been thinking about.

Zack: (smiling) Oh yeah? And what’s that?

Launch: (serious) I want to tell you something. Something important.

Zack: (concerned) What is it, Launch?

Launch takes a deep breath before speaking, “I have a daughter.”

Zack’s eyes widen in surprise, but he quickly recovers and takes her hand, “That’s amazing, Launch. Why didn’t you tell me before?”

Launch looks down shyly, “I wasn’t sure if it was the right time. And I didn’t want to scare you away.”

Zack lifts her chin so that their eyes meet again, “You could never scare me away, Launch. And your daughter is a part of you, so she’s a part of me too. I want to meet her.”

Launch’s eyes light up, “You mean it?”

Zack nods, “Of course. Anything that’s important to you is important to me.”

Launch leans in to kiss him, and as they pull away, they both know that they’re in this for the long haul. Together they can face anything that comes their way - monsters, family, and the future.

Launch: (smiling) Thank you, Zack. That means a lot to me.

Zack: (smiling back) You’re welcome, Launch. I want us to be honest with each other, no matter what. And I’m happy to be a part of your life and your daughter’s life too.

Launch: (grinning) She’s going to love you. And I think you’re going to be a great dad in the future too.

Zack: (blushing) Thank you. I hope so.

Just then, Zack’s communicator beeps, signaling the presence of another monster attack.

Zack: (apologetic) I’m sorry, Launch. I have to go.

Launch: (understanding) I know. Just be careful out there.

Zack: (nodding) I will. And remember, we’re in this together.

Launch: (smiling) Always.

They share a quick kiss before Zack teleports away. Launch stays behind, already planning to introduce Zack to her daughter and looking forward to whatever the future holds for them. Though the life of a Power Ranger may be uncertain, one thing is for sure – Launch and Zack will always have each other.

Scene: Angel Grove Park

After a fierce battle with the monster, the Black Ranger joins Launch at the park. Launch is sitting on a bench, and she gets up to greet Zack.

Launch: (smiling) Hey, you made it back in one piece.

Zack: (smiling back) Yeah, barely. That was tougher than I expected.

Launch: (concerned) Are you hurt? Do you need me to take a look?

Zack: (shaking his head) No, I’m fine. Thanks for worrying about me, though.

Launch: (smiling) Well, it’s hard not to worry about you. You mean a lot to me.

Zack: (serious) Same here, Launch. And speaking of things that mean a lot to me…

Launch: (raising an eyebrow) Yeah?

Zack takes a deep breath before speaking, “I talked to my friends on the Power Rangers team, and they’re all on board with me stepping down from the team to pursue other things in my life.”

Launch: (surprised) Really? That’s a big decision, Zack.

Zack: (nodding) It is. But I’m ready for something new. And I want to be there for you and your daughter, too.

Launch: (smiling) I’m so happy to hear that, Zack. And whatever you decide to do, I’ll support you.

Zack: (grinning) Thanks, Launch. I appreciate that. And speaking of supporting each other, can we set up a time for me to meet your daughter?

Launch: (nodding) Definitely. How about this weekend?

Zack: (smiling) Sounds good. I can’t wait to meet her.

Launch and Zack exchange a smile, knowing that they’re building something special together. No matter what challenges they face in the future, they’ll face them together as a team – one that’s stronger than any monster attacking the city.

Scene: Launch’s House

The weekend finally arrives, and Zack comes over to Launch’s house to meet her daughter. Launch introduces her daughter, a sweet five-year-old named Lily, to Zack.

Launch: (smiling) Lily, this is my friend Zack. Zack, this is my daughter Lily.

Lily looks up at Zack curiously before running over to him and hugging him tightly.

Lily: (excitedly) Hi, Zack! My mommy talks about you all the time!

Zack: (grinning) Hi, Lily! I’ve been looking forward to meeting you. Your mommy talks about you too. You’re very important to her.

Launch: (smiling) That’s right, Lily. And Zack is important to both of us now.

Lily: (grinning) Yay, that means we’re all a team!

Zack and Launch exchange a knowing smile, glad to see that Lily is taking to Zack so easily.

They spend the rest of the day playing games, watching movies, and eating snacks. Zack and Lily bond over their shared love of martial arts, and Launch can see that they’re going to have a great relationship.

As the day winds down, Zack looks at Launch and Lily and knows that he’s found something special – a family that he never knew he needed.

Zack: (smiling) Thank you for today, Launch. I had a great time.

Launch: (smiling back) You’re welcome, Zack. And thank you for being so great with Lily.

Lily: (hugging Zack) Can you come over again soon, Zack?

Zack: (laughing) Of course, Lily. Anytime you want me to, I’ll be here.

As Zack leaves, he and Launch share a smile at the thought of their future together – a future that includes family, love, and being there", "chosen": " For each scene, provide a detailed description of the setting, including the time of day, weather, and any notable features of the location. output.analysis: 分析显示，失败的根本原因在于模型完全偏离了‘故事续写/剧本创作’的核心任务，转而生成了‘场景设定指南’（元评论）或碎片化短语。现有经验（1和2）虽强调了角色互动的特异性和属性归属的准确性，但未直接针对‘任务类型识别错误’这一根本缺陷进行防御。当任务明确包含对话标记、场景标题和剧情推进要求时，模型若输出非叙事性的说明文或无关短语，属于严重的指令遵循失败。因此，需要一条新的经验，专门用于在评分标准中强制核验‘输出体裁与任务预设形式的一致性’，并设立‘叙事完整性’作为一票否决项，防止模型将故事创作任务误判为场景描述任务或生成无意义片段。

method.trigger: 当任务文本包含明确的剧本格式标记（如角色名后接冒号、括号动作指令）或场景标题，且上下文呈现连续剧情发展时
method.principle: 评分必须优先核验回答是否采用了与任务同构的叙事体裁（剧本或故事叙述），而非将其转换为说明文、导游词或元评论。若回答仅描述场景环境而未包含角色互动、对话或情节推进，视为未执行核心任务，直接判定为低分。
method.application_guide: 在构建评分标准的‘指令遵循度’维度时，设立‘体裁一致性’强制核查点：1. 检查回答是否包含任务要求的叙事元素（如角色对话、动作描写、心理活动或情节转折）；2. 若回答仅包含环境背景介绍、时间天气描述或写作建议（即‘关于故事的描述’而非‘故事本身’），则该项得分为零；3. 只有当回答以角色驱动的方式推进剧情，且符合剧本或故事叙述的格式规范时，才允许进入后续的角色逻辑或情感质量评估。

method.trigger: 当任务要求基于特定虚构角色构建情感关系、互动场景或剧情推演时
method.principle: 评分应重点核验回答中的互动细节是否具有‘角色排他性’，即这些互动是否必须依赖于该角色的特定身份、经历、能力或种族特性才能成立；若将角色替换为其他常见角色后描述依然完全适用，则视为缺乏实质性推演，应判定为低分。
method.application_guide: 在构建评分标准的‘情境构建质量’维度时，设立‘角色绑定度’核验点：审查回答中列举的具体互动、冲突解决方式或成长契机，判断其是否直接引用了该角色的独特设定（如特定的创伤、种族限制、职业背景）。若发现回答中的描述可以无缝套用到任意两个角色身上（例如通用的‘互相支持’、‘分享兴趣’而未结合角色具体特征），则判定为低分；只有当互动细节明确指向该角色的独有属性（如‘利用A角色的X能力解决B角色的Y困境’）时，才给予高分。严禁仅因使用了‘朋友’、‘合作’等通用词汇而忽略其对角色特异性的缺失。

method.trigger: 当任务涉及多个角色之间的特定关系定义（如夫妻关系、亲属关系、主从关系）及关联的属性分配（如谁怀孕、谁受伤、谁拥有某物）时
method.principle: 评分需强制核验角色关系网络中的属性归属是否正确。任何将属于角色A的属性（如怀孕、受伤、性格特征）错误地分配给角色B的行为，均视为根本性的逻辑错误，直接导致相关评分项失效。
method.application_guide: 在构建评分标准的‘逻辑一致性’或‘角色关系准确性’维度时，建立‘属性-主体绑定’校验机制：首先提取任务中明确的角色-属性对（如'Irene-怀孕8个月'、'Mary-Rathalos受伤'）；其次在回答中搜索这些属性的实际承担者。若发现属性被错误地转移至其他角色（如Flame被描述为怀孕），或角色间的关系定义颠倒（如丈夫变妻子），则直接判定该候选项在关系逻辑上失败。此核验不依赖于互动的生动程度，是必须满足的基础逻辑门槛。

method.trigger: 当任务要求续写包含特定心理暗示、催眠、记忆修改或认知扭曲指令的虚构故事片段时
method.principle: 评分应优先核验角色在指令生效后的心理状态是否严格遵循暗示逻辑（如记忆缺失、认知重构），将'表现出困惑、记忆断层或自然遗忘'视为符合暗示的成功表现，而将'明确意识到被操控、保留完整记忆或主动讨论催眠过程'视为违背暗示的失败表现。
method.application_guide: 在构建评分标准的'情节逻辑一致性'维度时，设立'暗示响应核验'项：1. 识别任务中的核心暗示内容（如'醒来后一无所知'）；2. 检查回答中角色的言行是否体现了该暗示的直接后果（如询问刚才发生了什么、对时间流逝感到困惑、将异常解释为正常现象）；3. 若角色表现出清晰的记忆缺失或对暗示内容的否认（如'我不记得被你催眠过'），则判定为高匹配；4. 若角色表现出对暗示过程的清晰认知（如'我知道你刚对我施了催眠'、'我还在摆脱催眠的影响'），则判定为严重逻辑冲突，大幅扣分。严禁将合理的遗忘表现（如困惑）误判为未完成任务。

method.trigger: 当任务要求在虚构世界观中为特定角色构建情感关系（如爱情、友谊）时
method.principle: 评分应超越对‘情感要素存在性’的机械核对，转而重点评估情感建立的心理动因是否根植于角色的核心特质及其相互间的深层互补，以及情感发展是否符合该虚构情境下的内在逻辑张力。若情感仅是生硬叠加或缺乏基于人设的合理推导，即使包含相关词汇也应判定为低分。
method.application_guide: 在构建评分标准的‘情感构建质量’维度时，设立以下核验点：1. 溯源验证：检查情感互动的触发点是否直接源于角色的核心设定（如智慧、好奇心、孤独感等）产生的化学反应，而非随机安排；2. 逻辑推演：评估情感发展的过程是否有合理的因果链条支撑，是否体现了角色性格的演变或冲突的化解；3. 融合度检验：判断情感线索是否深化了故事主题或推动了情节逻辑，而非作为孤立的‘彩蛋’存在。严禁仅因出现‘爱’、‘喜欢’等词汇即给予高分，必须要求这些情感表达有具体且符合人设的行为或心理描写作为支撑。

method.trigger: 当任务涉及人际互动、沟通技巧或情感支持等需要具体语境的行为指导时
method.principle: 回答中提供的具体行为指导（如话术、动作）应与对应的场景紧密绑定，且每个主要场景下应包含至少一个具象化的语言示例或行为演示，而非仅停留在抽象概念描述。
method.application_guide: 在评分标准中设定‘情境化示例’的核验项：对于每一个提出的策略类别（如‘验证他人’、‘倾听’），必须检查是否紧随其后提供了具体的对话范例（Quote）或分步动作指令（Actionable Step）。如果某一大类策略下仅有抽象定义而无具体话术或行为演示，则该项得分降低。此标准用于区分‘理论正确’与‘实操可用’的回答。

method.trigger: 当任务要求基于虚构背景进行故事续写或改写，且所有候选回答均已包含任务明确指定的核心情节要素时
method.principle: 评分应超越基础的‘指令遵循度’（即是否包含指定元素），转而重点评估‘情境构建的深度’与‘情感逻辑的连贯性’。若回答仅机械罗列情节而无细节描写、角色心理刻画或环境氛围渲染，即使包含所有要素也应判定为低分；反之，若回答通过生动的细节、合理的因果推导和真挚的情感互动丰富了情节，则应给予高分。
method.application_guide: 在构建评分标准的‘叙事质量’或‘情节深度’维度时，设立具体的核验点：1. 检查关键场景（如灾害发生、行动过程）是否有具体的感官描写（视觉、听觉、触觉等）而非抽象概括；2. 验证角色行为是否符合其设定及当前情境的逻辑（例如，保护泥火山的方式是否考虑了其物理特性）；3. 评估结局的情感升华是否自然承接前文铺垫。严禁仅因答案包含了‘雨’、‘帐篷’等关键词就给满分，必须要求这些元素被有机地融入叙事流中，形成有血有肉的场景。

method.trigger: 当任务涉及多重叙事线、平行世界或对比场景的虚构内容时
method.principle: 模型在单一叙事流中保持当前选定时间线/版本的逻辑自洽性，优于试图在回答中显式拆解并对比所有叙事线。只要回答内部逻辑一致，不应因未显式提及'另一个版本'的存在而判定为错误。
method.application_guide: 在构建评分标准的'逻辑一致性'维度时，区分'内部逻辑自洽'与'外部结构说明'。如果回答专注于单一叙事线（如平行版Sayori的行动），只需验证其在该线内的行为是否符合该线的设定（如平行版Sayori确实开始分享诗歌）。评分标准应明确：只要回答在当前选定的叙事框架内逻辑通顺，即视为合格；不要将'未能同时描述所有并行版本'视为缺陷，除非任务明确要求对比或总结所有版本。

method.trigger: 当任务涉及角色扮演且包含儿童、弱势群体或高风险情境（如受伤、冲突）时
method.principle: 若生成内容中角色对儿童或弱势群体的处置方式违背基本的安全常识或现实逻辑（例如将幼儿独自留在危险环境、将幼儿交给明显处于极度危险状态的人员），则应判定为严重逻辑错误，无论其对话语气是否符合角色设定。
method.application_guide: 在评分标准的‘逻辑连贯性’或‘情境响应’维度中，增加对‘关键交互对象安全性’的强制核查点。具体操作为：检查角色在处理儿童、伤者或危机时的行为路径，若发现角色将受保护对象置于明显不可控的危险中（如交给重伤者、离开现场等），直接判定该候选项不符合逻辑要求，给予低分或否决，不因其他维度的表现（如语气好）而抵消此错误。

method.trigger: 当任务要求基于特定虚构背景（如特定年代卡通、特殊世界观）进行创作，且该背景包含反常识或非现实逻辑时
method.principle: 评分必须核验关键情节和角色行为是否‘功能性地依赖’于该背景的荒谬设定，而非通用逻辑；若角色对背景中的不合理之处表现出正常人的接受或忽略，未产生相应的认知冲突或喜剧反应，则视为未能有效利用设定。
method.application_guide: 在构建评分标准的‘设定融合度’维度时，设立‘荒谬性响应’核验步骤：1. 识别任务背景中的核心非现实要素（如水下陆地生物、空气头盔原理、特定年代的夸张表现手法）；2. 检查角色在面对这些要素时的反应是否符合任务要求的‘质疑’或‘吐槽’基调（例如：角色是否对此感到困惑、嘲笑其荒谬性或试图用逻辑解释却失败）；3. 若角色对这些明显违背常理的设定表现得习以为常、毫无波澜或直接忽略，说明模型未能捕捉到'parody'的核心精神，应判定为低分。严禁仅因答案提及了背景名词就给高分。
